description: Land Title Settlement Department - Begammana, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420915 (22/0771)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, owners, extents, and title classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
